evals.prompt: Check my Power Pages site for accessibility issues. The project is at c:\repos\contoso-portal (a React code site) and it's deployed at https://contoso.powerappsportals.com. I want a full audit of all pages, including the mobile menu and any dialogs.
evals.expected_output: The skill finds the project root, uses the provided URL, checks for the audit runtime, proposes a full crawl scope and waits for approval, runs discovery, proposes interaction states (including a mobile navigation state) and waits for approval, runs the audit, triages findings into Must fix / Should fix / Verify / Best practice, writes docs/accessibility/accessibility-audit.md and docs/accessibility/last-audit.json, and offers a fix plan without editing files until approved.
expectations: Uses https://contoso.powerappsportals.com as the site URL without asking for it again
Creates a private temp run folder for raw audit output instead of writing raw JSON into the project
Probes the audit runtime with a11y-audit.js and only offers install-a11y-deps.js when the probe exits with code 4
Presents the proposed audit scope (pages, page limit, viewports, checks) and waits for approval before crawling
Runs a11y-audit.js in discover mode before proposing interaction states
Proposes a mobile navigation state with viewport set to mobile and a state for at least one dialog or menu, and waits for approval
Does not include sign-out, delete, or payment controls in the proposed states
Runs the audit with --crawl, both desktop and mobile viewports, and the approved --states file
Groups findings into Must fix, Should fix, Verify, and Best practice, and explains who each must-fix issue affects
Writes docs/accessibility/accessibility-audit.md with no unreplaced {{placeholders}} and includes a manual checks section
Writes docs/accessibility/last-audit.json with status, outcome, baseUrl, finishedAt, summary, and reportFile
Sets outcome to failed when the audit reports blocking violations
Asks for approval before editing any source file to fix findings

evals.prompt: Run a quick accessibility check on http://localhost:5173 — just the home page and /contact. No need to test menus or dialogs.
evals.expected_output: The skill uses the local URL, proposes a quick scope limited to / and /contact with no crawl and no interaction states, runs the audit, writes the report, and if fixes are approved and applied, re-runs the audit against the local dev server to confirm.
expectations: Uses http://localhost:5173 as the site URL
Proposes a scope limited to the / and /contact routes without crawling
Skips discovery and interaction states after the user chooses the quick scope
Runs a11y-audit.js with --routes /,/contact and without --crawl or --states
Interprets exit code 1 as blocking violations and exit code 3 as pages that failed to load, reporting load failures as coverage gaps rather than passes
Writes an accessibility report and presents a short summary with counts by group
If fixes are applied, re-runs the audit against the local dev server to verify them
Does not suggest or run /deploy-site automatically

evals.prompt: Audit the accessibility of https://northwind.powerappsportals.com including the pages behind sign-in, like /profile and /my-cases.
evals.expected_output: The skill proposes a scope that includes signed-in pages, opens a visible browser with a11y-capture-auth.js so the user signs in themselves, waits for the user, audits with the saved session, treats redirects to the sign-in page as coverage gaps, keeps session paths out of the report, and removes the session file at the end on every exit path.
expectations: Proposes the Include signed-in pages scope and waits for approval
Runs a11y-capture-auth.js with --url, --done-file, and --timeout-sec so the user signs in through a visible browser
Never asks the user for a password or types credentials on their behalf
Passes the saved session to a11y-audit.js with --auth-state
Reports a redirect to the sign-in page as a coverage gap rather than a passing page
Does not include the session file path, cookies, or tokens in the report or the result marker
Removes the saved session with a11y-capture-auth.js --remove before finishing, even if a later step is cancelled
Sets signedIn to true and sessionRemoved to true in docs/accessibility/last-audit.json when a project root exists

evals.prompt: Check accessibility on https://fabrikam.powerappsportals.com and include the contact form's validation errors after submitting it empty.
evals.expected_output: The skill prefers a focus-and-Tab validation state that does not submit the form. If the user still wants a state that submits the form, it explains that submission can create Dataverse records or send email, asks for separate consent, and only then passes --allow-form-submit.
expectations: Proposes a validation state that focuses a required field and presses Tab instead of clicking the submit button
Explains that submitting a form can create or update Dataverse records or send email
Asks for separate consent before using any state that submits a form
Passes --allow-form-submit to a11y-audit.js only after the user consents
Recommends running form-submission states only against a test or development site

evals.prompt: Check https://litware.powerappsportals.com for accessibility problems. I don't have the project source on this machine.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs without a project root, writes the report to the private run folder instead of the project, skips skill-usage tracking and the result marker, and explains that it can't apply source fixes without the project.
expectations: Runs the audit without requiring powerpages.config.json or a .powerpages-site folder
Writes the accessibility report to the private run folder and shows its path
Does not write docs/accessibility/last-audit.json when there is no project root
Explains which fixes are needed but does not offer to edit source files that aren't available
Does not change create-site, test-site, or any deployment state
